## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Generate an IT (Information Technology) token.

### Data Read (17)
- `GET /ad/p/in/v1_0/imp` — Retrieve ad impression data.
- `GET /bc/{bcId}` — Retrieve details for a specific BC ID.
- `GET /bc/banner-main/{banner-mainId}` — Retrieve data for a specific main banner.
- `GET /bc/detail/gov/bas` — Retrieve government basic details.
- `GET /bc/dgnos/3dview` — Retrieve 3D diagnostic view data.
- `GET /bc/kw/active/promo` — Retrieve active promotion keywords.
- `GET /cam/fetch-slot/{fetch-slotId}` — Retrieve data for a specific fetch slot.
- `GET /common/getSvrTime` — Get the server time.
- `GET /cs/faqList` — Get a list of FAQs.
- `GET /ds/menu` — Retrieve menu data.
- `GET /mp/alm-box` — Retrieve ALM box data.
- `GET /nac/2` — Retrieve NAC data.
- `GET /pagead/conversion/{conversionId}/` — Retrieve conversion data.
- `GET /sid/json` — Retrieve session ID information.
- `GET /sync` — Synchronize data with the server.
- `GET /v1/cm/{cmId}` — Retrieve details for a specific CM ID.
- `GET /v1/usersync` — Synchronize user data.

### Data Write (6)
- `POST /api/v3/data/` — Submit data to the m-kcar system.
- `POST /b` — Create or update general data.
- `POST /bc/mma/info` — Update MMA (Mobile Marketing Automation) information.
- `POST /bc/wish-yn-list` — Update wish list status for cars.
- `POST /p/c` — Create or update car data.
- `POST /tags/v2` — Submit tag data.

### Search (2)
- `POST /bc/search/list` — Search for cars based on criteria.
- `POST /bc/search/list/drct` — Search for direct listings.

### Config (1)
- `GET /getconfig/sodar` — Get configuration settings.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to M Kcar's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access M Kcar data without official API access
- Automate actions on mapi.kcar.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the M Kcar frontend uses
